issues.issue: Individual department columns on the combining schedule don't add to their printed column totals, although the fund total ties exactly. On a second read the Cemetery digits are 1,491 / 115 / 14,164 / 1,126 / 628 / 47 / 943 / 6,450. The page shows rounding throughout (row totals for Salaries, Supplies and Contract labor are also off by 1), so this is most likely the report's rounding. p12 utility subtotals are similar (Sewer production 112,891 vs 112,890; Electric/Water/Sewer G&A off by 1).

The category list puts TIF in economic development. The extractor kept general government because the p4 statement counts it there. This is inconsistent with recategorizing detail by what the line is (cf. noxious weed).

Fire department lines (detail[69]-[78]) are categorized general government because the p4 statement prints the Fire column total as 'Public buildings'. The budget schedule (p9) calls it 'Public works - other'. The Statement of Activities (p2) spreads it between Public safety (126,194) and Culture and recreation (294,101). The column heading 'Fire' points to public safety. This is a judgment call; the same applies to disbursements[4] 'Public buildings' 87,339.

Cemetery lines (detail[47]-[54]) are categorized public safety to tie to the p4 'Public safety' 63,817 (Rescue + Cemetery; the budget schedule calls it 'Public health and safety'). The category rules put cemetery in health/welfare.
An unlabeled 'Other' disbursement was assumed to be interest/fees. The statement counts it in Debt service 164,985, so debt service (principal and interest combined) would avoid the assumption.
